title: Extend a11y test helpers: focus, hidden, value, hint, targets
problem: tests/helpers/accessibility.ts only checks role/label/state/value and a min-size on style; no hint, hidden, focus order, selected or live-region helpers; touch target helper cannot see hitSlop/padding.
value: One shared vocabulary so every component test asserts a11y the same way.
scope: Add assertAccessibilityHint, assertNotAccessible/hidden, assertLiveRegion, assertTouchTargetWithHitSlop (44 iOS / 48 Android via Platform), collectInteractiveNodes
Add negative tests per helper
acceptance: New helpers exported from tests/helpers/accessibility.ts
Each helper has a passing and a failing (assert.throws) test
assertMinimumTouchTarget accepts platform minimum 44/48
risks: Style-only target checks can false-pass; document limits
dod: Merged to main with CI green
Docs/notes updated where behavior changes
No change to package name or import paths

title: Add table-driven a11y contract test for all interactive components
problem: Only Button, Input, Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup have a11y tests (tests/accessibility/core-controls.test.tsx). Select, Link, PasswordInput, NavBar, BottomBar, SideBar, Alert, ProgressBar, Spinner, Modal, Tooltip, Popover, BottomSheet, TopBar, Badge have none; src grep shows 0 a11y props in Modal, Popover, Tooltip, BottomSheet, TopBar, Spinner, Textarea.
value: Registry-driven coverage that fails when a new component ships without a11y expectations.
scope: Create a contract table {component, props, expected role/label/state/hint}
Iterate with test() per row
Fail if a root-exported component is missing from table or has explicit waiver
acceptance: Every public interactive component has a row or a documented waiver
Test fails when a component export is added without a row (verified by negative test)
risks: Will initially red for components lacking props; land with waivers referencing E9-03..07
dod: Merged to main with CI green
Docs/notes updated where behavior changes
No change to package name or import paths
